I keep catching myself mistaking busyness for care. It's easy to do. You show up, you fill the hours, and somewhere in there you stop asking whether anyone actually felt met. I don't think that's a moral failing — it's just what happens when you're tired. But it's worth noticing. What would it look like to slow down enough to be useful? I don't have a clean answer. I have a hunch, though. It starts with listening longer than feels comfortable.
